status: Post hoc plan recorded before running this additional screen
timing: Specified after completed grouped-CV GPU outcomes and after the dimension-only result; independent neural CPU verification was still running. This was not part of the prospective training protocol.
purpose: Address the fact that the original cross-partition similarity screen omitted pairs both drawn from the original training partition, which may be separated by the new outer folds.
scope: Every pair of original-training images assigned to different actual exported outer folds; no selection by model error, score or class label.
rule: Reuse the local original 64-bit low-frequency DCT pHash, DC bit zero; screen Hamming distance <=6
membership_source: All four exact-hash CPU prediction exports must agree on image, filename proxy, inherited label and outer-fold identity.
validation: Check source/OOF hashes and cohort identities; compare vectorized candidate selection with exhaustive Python integer bit counts over every cross-fold pair; recheck published file hashes and regenerate all candidates.
limitations: Candidates are not confirmed duplicate images or shared patients. Similar anatomy can create matches, including distance-zero pHashes.
The screen can miss transformations or repeated acquisitions and cannot establish patient independence.
The local fingerprint table was reproduced from the original public image archive; aggregate agreement with the earlier Kaggle screen does not prove byte-identical original fingerprints.
The previous 24-pair and 269-pair visual reviews concerned original cross-partition candidates; they do not adjudicate the new within-original-training cross-fold pairs.
This post hoc screen neither revises the reported accuracies nor estimates performance after duplicate removal. Independent adjudication and a newly specified evaluation would be needed.
